story.text: There is no “framework” or “agenda” behind my experiments with things like [[Claim Template]], surveys, or [[Discourse Graphs]].

They are tools — not norms, not requirements, not expectations.

You can use them, ignore them, parody them, remix them, or build something totally different.
Nothing in your writing has to conform to anything I’m exploring.

Your page is your world.
Participation styles in the federation are fully heterogeneous.

This wiki aims to create possibilities, not obligations.
